title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 7
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q061_outdated
elements.title: The instructions are ___: they refer to buttons the new version no longer has.

elements.name: q062_contradiction
elements.title: There is a ___ between saying the room is empty and saying someone is inside.

elements.name: q063_wild_west
elements.title: With no clear rules and nobody enforcing standards, the new marketplace felt like the ___.

elements.name: q064_reimagining
elements.title: The architects are ___ the old station as a public library instead of restoring it as it was.

elements.name: q065_hangs_over
elements.title: The threat of closure ___ the theatre as it waits for a funding decision.

elements.name: q066_brinkmanship
elements.title: Which word describes deliberately escalating a risky dispute to pressure the other side to give in?

elements.name: q067_shaky
elements.title: The business is on ___ financial ground and may struggle to pay next month's bills.

elements.name: q068_evacuee
elements.title: What do we call someone moved away from an area because it is unsafe?

elements.name: q069_roots
elements.title: The study examined the ___ of the problem by looking for what originally caused it.

elements.name: q070_call_for
elements.title: Campaigners ___ an immediate review, saying further delay is unacceptable.
